title: 第21章 发现新主角？
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
照这样下去，她剩下的三百多万极品灵石恐怕都撑不到筑基就没了。

    还有神识空间里那四颗神兽蛋，哪个不是需要花费大量灵气才能孵化的主儿。

    这么一来，她现在拥有的灵石根本就不够看啊！

    “统子，怎么办，我突然感觉我现在好穷啊！”

    在意识到自己处处都需要花费灵石之后，微生璃月忽然生起一种紧迫感。

    要是不赶紧赚取装逼值，她迟早养不起这个家。

    “这……”

    “阿璃啊……”

    “要不我们多找几个地方大装特装，多赚一点装逼值，我看你装逼成长礼包里开出极品灵石的几率挺大的，说不定多开几个就能开出灵石了。”

    装逼系统也是第一次见练气期升级就能把周围灵气瞬间吸干，还要自己搭进去九十多万极品灵石的宿主。

    别说阿璃自己了，它都觉得她败家。

    再加上那几颗神兽蛋，阿璃身上这养家的担子可不轻。

    “行吧！”

    发现自己升级一次需要花费这么多极品灵石之后，微生璃月有些蔫了。

    但现在除了把赚灵石的希望寄托于装逼成长礼包以外，好像也没别的方法。

    走出卧房，看到四双眼睛齐齐盯着自己，微生璃月立马把那些愁绪丢掉，装出一副高冷神秘模样。

    “怎么样小师妹，你晋级成功了吗？”林不语第一个站出来询问。

    作为小师妹的忠诚仆人，在关心小师妹晋级这件事上，他必须得第一个站出来，要不然怎么能显示出他的忠心。

    “刚才没发生意外吧，我看这渡星槎都产生了异动。”陆明薇关心道。

    刚刚灵气消失的刹那，她明显感受到这附近的灵气根本供应不上小师妹吸收的速度。
content_en:
If this continues, her remaining three million or so top-quality spiritual stones may not be able to sustain the foundation building and will be gone.

There are also the four mythical beast eggs in the consciousness space, which ones require a lot of spiritual energy to hatch.

As a result, the spiritual stones she has now are simply not enough!

"Tongzi, what should I do? I suddenly feel that I am so poor now!"

After realizing that she needed to spend spirit stones everywhere, Wei Sheng Liyue suddenly felt a sense of urgency.

If she doesn't earn pretentious points quickly, sooner or later she won't be able to support the family.

"This..."

"Ah Li..."

"How about we find a few more places to install special decorations and earn more pretense points. I think there is a high chance that you will get the best spiritual stones in your pretentious growth gift pack. Maybe you can get the spiritual stones by opening a few more."

This is also the first time that the pretentious system can absorb the surrounding spiritual energy instantly when it is upgraded during the Qi training period, and it also has to be a host with more than 900,000 top-quality spiritual stones.

Not to mention Ali herself, it thought she was a waste of money.

Coupled with those mythical beast eggs, Ah Li's burden of supporting the family is not light.

"Okay!"

After discovering that she needed to spend so many top-quality spiritual stones to upgrade, Weisheng Liyue felt a little wilted.

But now there seems to be no other way besides pinning the hope of earning spiritual stones on the pretentious growth gift package.

When she walked out of the bedroom and saw four pairs of eyes staring at her, Weisheng Liyue immediately threw away those melancholy thoughts and pretended to be cold and mysterious.

"How's it going, little junior sister, have you been promoted successfully?" Lin Buyu was the first to stand up and ask.

As a loyal servant of Junior Sister, he must be the first to stand up when it comes to caring about Junior Sister's promotion, otherwise how can he show his loyalty.

"There was no accident just now, right? I see something happened in Duxingcha." Lu Mingwei said with concern.

The moment the spiritual energy disappeared, she clearly felt that the spiritual energy nearby could not be supplied at the speed that the junior sister could absorb it.
